---
title: "wrapped fixture: column page under column classes"
filters:
  - wrapped
column: page
format:
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
---

With `column: page` in the document and no `fig-column`, Quarto reads a
float's own `column-*` class before the document's `column`. So in PDF a
`column-body` float sits in the body, a `column-margin` float sits in the
margin, and a float with no column class is page-wide.
